text: Program Introduction If you could finish the Preparatory Program and pass the graduation test based on the subjects taught during the Preparatory Program, and don’t have any record of violating laws of China and regulations of the college during the study, you will be admitted to M.B.B.S. Program, Master Program or Doctor Program in our college( Autumn Session of 2015 ). Main Courses Elementary Chinese,General Introduction of China,Introduction to Sociology, Medical Physics, Medical Chemistry, Medical Biology, Physical Education(Taiji), etc. The courses also include two trips organized by the university. Study Duration 7 months Fee Structure Registration fee: 75 USD Tuition fee: 12000 RMB Hostel fee: 2300/person (double room) Others: pay required fees to the acceptors when processing physical exam, residence permit and insurance. All fees are not refundable and their use can’t be changed.
